# Test Card Policy

## 1. Limits

### 1.1 Grade caps

The maximum initial limit for grade A is USD 25,000. Grade B is capped at USD 15,000.

| Grade | Cap |
|---|---|
| A | 25,000 |
| B | 15,000 |

## 2. Charge-off

Credit card balances are charged off at 180 days past due.
